core_obligations: Adjunction composition (proof lines 988-997): with g = f composed with i, uniqueness of right adjoints gives b = c composed with a, hence omega_Y^bullet = c(omega_X^bullet).
Complex level (proof lines 997-1000): the closed-twisted-inverse-image lemma turns c into RSheafHom(O_Y, -), giving omega_Y^bullet = RSheafHom(O_Y, omega_X^bullet).
Sheaf level (proof lines 1000-1004): taking H^{-1} yields omega_Y = SheafHom(O_Y, omega_X), and the sheaf-with-exact-support lemma upgrades it to i_*omega_Y = SheafHom_{O_X}(i_*O_Y, omega_X).
proof_roadmap: Compose the adjoints along g = f i by uniqueness.
Identify the closed-subspace adjoint with RSheafHom.
Extract H^{-1} for the sheaf statement.
Upgrade to the pushforward SheafHom formula.

Every step is present with no omissions. H2: a compact adjunction argument with correctly ordered citations.
